The '''''Vinsor''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that saw use during the early stages of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Vinsor'' was deployed to support the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] during the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|battle]] of [[Centerpoint Station]].
